declaration.preface:
This Fair Wage Policy (“Policy”) is established by Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (“the Company”) to ensure fair, equitable, and lawful compensation practices across all its operations and workforce.

The Company is committed to integrating fair wage principles into its human resource management systems, payroll processes, and overall employment practices. This Policy outlines the Company’s objectives, key focus areas—including minimum wage compliance, equal pay for equal work, wage transparency, and timely payment—and the mechanisms for monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

The Company has adopted appropriate systems, controls, and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory wage requirements and to promote a culture of fairness, equity, and respect for workers’ rights across all levels of the organization.
declaration.declaration:
To ensure that all employees receive fair wages that meet or exceed applicable statutory requirements and support basic living needs.

To promote equitable, transparent, and consistent wage practices across all levels of the organization.

To support employee well-being, dignity, and financial stability through responsible compensation practices.

To ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, wage regulations, and statutory requirements.

To prevent unfair wage practices, including delayed payments, unauthorized deductions, and wage discrimination.

To promote equal opportunity and non-discriminatory compensation practices, including equal pay for equal work.

To strengthen transparency, accountability, and accuracy in payroll and wage administration processes.

To encourage continuous improvement in wage practices through periodic review and alignment with economic conditions and industry standards.
declaration.scope: This Fair Wage Policy (“Policy”) applies to all operations, activities, and facilities of Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (“the Company”). It is applicable to all employees at all levels, as well as contractors, suppliers, service providers, business partners, and any other individuals or entities working on behalf of the Company.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd adopts a structured and transparent approach to determine living wage levels to ensure employees receive remuneration that supports a decent standard of living.

Legal Compliance: Wages are first aligned with all applicable statutory minimum wage laws and labor regulations in the respective operating locations.

Benchmarking Approach: Living wage levels are assessed using credible external references such as government wage data, recognized wage studies, and relevant regional or international living wage benchmarks.

Cost of Living Consideration: Wage adequacy is evaluated based on essential living costs, including food, housing, healthcare, education, transportation, and other basic household needs.

Geographical Context: Living wage determination considers regional variations in cost of living to ensure relevance to local economic conditions.

Family Needs Perspective: Wage assessment considers the needs of employees and a reasonable number of dependents to support a basic but decent standard of living.

Periodic Review: Living wage benchmarks are reviewed periodically to reflect inflation, economic changes, and updated benchmark data.

Continuous Improvement: The Company is committed to progressively improving wage structures over time, in line with business sustainability and responsible business practices.

Living Wage Consideration: Integrate living wage principles into the organization’s compensation philosophy to ensure fair and adequate remuneration for all employees.

Continuously strengthen wage adequacy by aligning compensation structures with recognized living wage benchmarks and socio-economic conditions.

Embed cost-of-living considerations into compensation review processes to ensure sustainable and fair wage determination.

Fair Wage Practices: Ensure fair, equitable, and transparent wage practices across all employees in alignment with statutory requirements and organizational standards.
Strengthen payroll governance systems to ensure complete transparency, traceability, and accountability in wage processing.
Foster a culture of timely and accurate wage disbursement as part of responsible employment practices.
Promote zero-tolerance towards unauthorized or non-compliant wage deductions through robust internal controls and audit mechanisms.
Living Wage Consideration: Integrate living wage principles into the organization’s compensation philosophy to ensure fair and adequate remuneration for all employees.
Continuously strengthen wage adequacy by aligning compensation structures with recognized living wage benchmarks and socio-economic conditions.
Embed cost-of-living considerations into compensation review processes to ensure sustainable and fair wage determination.
Compliance with Labour Laws: Maintain strong adherence to all applicable labour laws related to wages, compensation, and employee benefits.
Ensure full integration of statutory wage provisions and benefits into organizational HR and payroll systems.
Promote a culture of legal compliance and ethical wage practices across all operational levels.
Continuous Improvement Targets: Foster continuous awareness and understanding of living wage principles among employees through regular communication and engagement initiatives.
Institutionalize periodic wage structure reviews to ensure ongoing alignment with living wage expectations and market conditions.
Drive continuous improvement in wage competitiveness through benchmarking, market analysis, and progressive compensation enhancement strategies.

policy.monitoring:
At Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd, structured monitoring and reporting systems are established to track fair wage and living wage performance and ensure transparency and continuous improvement.

Monitoring: Key wage-related parameters (minimum wage compliance, living wage alignment, compensation equity, and payroll accuracy) are monitored against defined KPIs on a periodic basis. Results are compiled into performance dashboards for management review.

Internal Audits: Payroll and wage compliance audits are conducted at least once a year across applicable functions. Audit findings are reported to senior management and corrective actions are tracked to closure.

Management Review: Senior management reviews wage performance, benchmarking outcomes, audit findings, and progress against targets at defined intervals. Outputs from these reviews support compensation planning and policy improvements.

Benchmarking Analysis: Wages are periodically benchmarked against regional living wage standards, industry practices, and cost-of-living indicators to ensure informed and fair compensation decisions.

Non-Compliance Management: Wage-related discrepancies, including payroll errors or deviations from approved structures, are recorded, investigated, and addressed through defined corrective action mechanisms.

Documentation & Data Integrity: Accurate, confidential, and auditable records of payroll, wage structures, and compensation reviews are maintained to ensure traceability and accountability.

External Reporting: Wage and living wage performance is communicated through internal reporting systems and external disclosures, where applicable.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Fair Wage Policy is subject to periodic review by the HR Manager at least once every two years, or earlier if required due to changes in labour laws, regulatory requirements, operational needs, or stakeholder feedback, to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with evolving statutory obligations and organizational objectives.

The review process includes an assessment of wage compliance status, internal equity and fairness, benchmarking against industry standards, and feedback from relevant stakeholders. Based on this evaluation, necessary updates are incorporated to strengthen the policy framework and ensure alignment with applicable labour regulations, fair wage principles, and the Company’s commitment to equitable and responsible compensation practices.
